title: SR-GP Evo Apex TC-1

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Serving closed-circuit and supersport riders, the Suomy SR-GP Evo Apex TC-1 is purpose-built for closed-course competition and apex carving. Featuring a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber architecture at a featherweight 1340g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across ECE 22.06, FIM certifications with an acoustically tuned ~93 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: FIM-homologated race helmet worn in World Superbike Championship.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Aggressive track fit; requires cheek pads for full-face closure on most adults.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Suomy SR-GP Evo Apex TC-1: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Suomy's Track / Race lineup, the SR-GP Evo Apex TC-1 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06, FIM track safety.
story:
The Suomy SR-GP Evo Apex TC-1 represents Suomy's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~93 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Suomy SR-GP Evo Apex TC-1 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
